title: DataSourceDeleteConflictResponse
description: 409 response body for DELETE /api/data-sources/:id when any persisted configuration still references the source (HEL-987/HEL-989, widened by HEL-1252 from pipeline roots to every reference kind: pipeline root, join/lookup/union secondary input, upsert target, form-panel binding). `resourceKind`/`resourceId`/`resourceName` identify the SOURCE. `pipelines` and `panels` list ONLY referencing resources the caller can see; any hidden reference still blocks the delete but contributes only the counts `hiddenPipelineCount`/`hiddenPanelCount` (and an unnamed mention in `reason`).

hiddenPipelineCount.description: Referencing pipelines the caller cannot see: a COUNT only, never an identity.

hiddenPanelCount.description: Referencing form panels the caller cannot see: a COUNT only, never an identity.
